description: In front of you on the green-covered surface there’s a small metal rack holding a shallow tray filled with colorful plastic utensils, and an open space on the table in front of it. The right hand reaches in from the right, grips a stack of utensils from the tray, lifts them out, and sets them down on the table, then returns to the tray to remove more pieces and drops them onto the growing pile; the utensils are the right-hand object during each lift and become no-hand objects once released.
